lines.en: Look at this mural, Isabel. It was painted by a woman from this street.
lines.pt: Olhe este mural, Isabel. Ele foi pintado por uma mulher desta rua.

lines.en: It is beautiful. Was she born in Chicago?
lines.pt: É lindo. Ela nasceu em Chicago?

lines.en: No, she wasn’t. She was born in a small town, and she grew up on a farm.
lines.pt: Não. Ela nasceu numa cidade pequena e cresceu numa fazenda.

lines.en: Like my grandmother! She was born on a farm too, and she moved here at twenty.
lines.pt: Como a minha avó! Ela também nasceu numa fazenda e se mudou para cá aos vinte anos.

lines.en: Really? Where was your grandmother born?
lines.pt: Sério? Onde a sua avó nasceu?

lines.en: In a village near a big lake. Her neighbors were farmers, and the school was very small.
lines.pt: Num vilarejo perto de um grande lago. Os vizinhos eram fazendeiros, e a escola era muito pequena.

lines.en: And was she happy when she moved to the city?
lines.pt: E ela ficou feliz quando se mudou para a cidade?

lines.en: Yes and no. She missed her hometown, but she found a good job here.
lines.pt: Sim e não. Ela sentia falta da cidade natal, mas achou um bom emprego aqui.

lines.en: Look, there is a plaque on the wall. It says the mural was made in 1998.
lines.pt: Olhe, tem uma placa na parede. Diz que o mural foi feito em 1998.

lines.en: I was born in 1998 too! That is a nice memory for me.
lines.pt: Eu nasci em 1998 também! Essa é uma boa lembrança para mim.

lines.en: Then this mural is your age. I was born two years later, in the spring.
lines.pt: Então este mural tem a sua idade. Eu nasci dois anos depois, na primavera.

work.note: Torre de pedra construída em Chicago em 1869. Ela foi uma das poucas construções que sobraram do grande incêndio de 1871 e hoje é um símbolo da cidade. A cidade tem muitas histórias: “It was built in 1869.” A cena desta aula é original; não reproduz a obra.

facts.big: She was born in a small town
facts.label: Was born / grew up
facts.sub: Use was/were born para o nascimento e grew up para a infância: I was born in 1998 and grew up on a farm.

facts.label: nasceu / nasceram
facts.sub: Use was born para uma pessoa e were born para várias: I was born in 1998. They were born in Chicago. Não diga “I born”. O verbo to be é obrigatório.

facts.label: cresceu
facts.sub: Use grew up para o lugar da infância: She grew up on a farm. I grew up in a small town. O passado de grow up é grew up.

compare.ask: She was born in a small town.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Eu nasci em 1998”, com o verbo nascer.
compare.tip: Diga: “She was born in a small town.”
compare.us: Em inglês, nascer é was/were born: I was born in 1998. She was born in a small town. They were born in Chicago. Não use o passado simples born sozinho. Para infância, use grew up.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.

pages.title: A street in Chicago · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a bright Sunday in Chicago. Isabel and Dot walk down a long street. There are murals on many walls. Dot likes to take photos of them. Isabel talks about her family. The wind from the lake is cold.

“Look at this mural, Isabel. It was painted by a woman from this street.” says Dot. “It is beautiful. Was she born in Chicago?” says Isabel. “No, she wasn’t. She was born in a small town, and she grew up on a farm.” says Dot.
